set.body: Purpose: add breadth only after the trust milestone closes, with every paper-named method carrying an algorithm card, truthful interface, conformance fixtures, benchmark evidence, limitations, and exact provenance. Scope: annotated detector benchmarks; I2MC-compatible and REMoDNaV-compatible families; dynamic AOIs and pupillometry foundations; MultiMatch and advanced comparison conformance; a psychology-facing facade and task-first documentation. Exit criteria: all child work is closed; the application never switches detectors silently; JVM and Scala.js results agree where supported; validation artifacts name datasets, versions, configurations, metrics, platform, and commit digest.
set.title: Phase 2: validated scientific breadth
